resources.string: You can now use the WearOS app to enable/disable the hotspot
You need to grant permission to write settings

spoton allows you to enable the hotspot on your device from your Android Wear watch.

The app on the phone is just a receiver for the watch app. Make sure to have the app installed on your watch too.

Make sure to enable the permission to write system settings to allow the app to enable the hotspot.
Please install spoton on your WearOS device
From Android 16 onwards, this app will no longer be supported due to system limitations.
